# **1\. Introduction & Design System**

This document presents 22 high-fidelity screen designs for the Qala Universal Solution Management OS. Each screen is rendered in dark mode using the Qala design system and is accompanied by a full annotation table describing every interactive element, state, and accessibility consideration.

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Background | \#0B0F19 (BG) · \#111827 (BG2) · \#16213A (BG3) | Three-tier dark surface hierarchy |
| Accent / Action | \#388BFD  Action Blue | All interactive affordances: buttons, links, focus rings |
| Success | \#22C564  Green | Gate passed, approved, active, deployed states |
| Warning | \#F59E0B  Amber | Medium risk, awaiting review, pending action |
| Danger | \#EF4444  Red | Error, critical alert, quarantined, recall |
| AI Feature | \#8B5CF6  Purple | AI Agent indicator, recommendation cards, AI actions |
| Domain / Teal | \#14B8A6  Teal | Active state, domain extension, workbench type |
| Text Primary | \#F0F5FF  Near-white | All primary body text, headings on dark surfaces |
| Text Secondary | \#CBD5E1  Slate 300 | Metadata, captions, placeholder, hint text |
| Typography | DejaVu Sans \+ DejaVu Sans Mono | Sans for all UI; Mono for IDs, versions, checksums, logs |
| Border Radius | 4px (inputs) · 8px (buttons/cards) · 10px (major cards) · 14px (modals) | Progressive radius scale |
| Spacing Base | 8px grid | All spacing in multiples of 8px |

**Persona-Adaptive Vocabulary Layer**

Qala serves 8 domain personas on a single unified platform. The vocabulary layer activates at login and adapts sidebar labels, empty-state messaging, and page titles based on the user's domain. The underlying component structure is identical across all domains.

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Platform Term | Software | CPG / Pharma |
| Development Environment | SDE | Formulation Workbench |
| Build / Compile | Build | Simulation Run |
| Quality Gate | CI Quality Gate | Batch Release Gate |
| Release | Software Release | Batch Release |
| Artefact | Container Image / Package | Specification / CoA |

# **2\. User Flow Map**

The following table maps each of the 12 primary user flows to the screens they traverse. Screen identifiers link to the annotated screen designs in Section 3\.

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UF-01  New User Onboarding | SC-01 Login  →  SC-02 Onboarding  →  SC-03 Dashboard  →  SC-06 SDE Detail  →  SC-07 Pipeline | Onboarding |
| UF-02  CPG Change Control | SC-04 Solutions  →  SC-08 CCR Detail  →  SC-06 Workbench  →  SC-09 Release | CPG Governance |
| UF-03  Software Release | SC-05 Solution  →  SC-07 Pipeline  →  SC-09 Release Gates  →  SC-09 Deploy | Software Release |
| UF-05  Security Incident | SC-19 Quarantine  →  SC-19 Forensics  →  SC-06 Recovery  →  SC-10 Audit | Security Response |
| UF-06  AI Recommendation | SC-13 AI Panel  →  SC-08 CCR Auto  →  SC-06 Applied  →  SC-03 Dashboard | AI-Assisted |
| UF-12  Compliance Exam | SC-11 Evidence  →  SC-11 Regulator  →  SC-10 Audit  →  SC-21 Notify | Compliance |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Logo \+ Tagline | QALA wordmark centred on Brand Navy card (480px wide) | Static — not a link in unauthenticated state |
| SSO Button | Primary full-width button — triggers SAML/OIDC redirect | Autofocus on load; org domain pre-filled if detectable |
| Email Input | Standard email type input | Validates on blur; autofocus if SSO not detected |
| Password Input | type=password with eye-toggle visibility | Inline error on invalid credentials below field |
| Remember Me | Checkbox \+ Forgot Password link on right | Forgot opens email-entry modal (separate flow) |
| Sign In Button | Secondary primary button | Disabled until both fields non-empty; spinner on submit |
| Request Access | Link to public marketing trial form | Routes outside the authenticated app |

![][image7]

|  | Design Notes Pipeline uses a horizontal node-connector layout. The stage nodes use 52px circles. The log panel uses a near-black (\#060A14) background with monospace font for terminal output. The AI risk banner uses PURPLE\_DIM fill with left accent border. |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Build Metadata Strip | Build number, status badge, commit SHA, branch, elapsed time | Live updates every 2 seconds; SHA links to source commit |
| Stage Nodes | 8 connected pipeline stages: Commit → Build → SAST → SCA → Test → Gate → Attest → Publish | Green \= Passed, Blue animated ring \= Running, Grey \= Pending, Red \= Failed |
| Running Stage | Blue animated border ring on active stage node | Reduced motion: static blue border replaces animation |
| Stage Log Panel | Live streaming log output for the active stage | Copy button, filter input, auto-scroll toggle |
| Stage Connector Lines | Horizontal lines between nodes coloured by upstream stage result | Turns green as stages pass; red on failure stops progression |
| AI Risk Overlay | Purple banner: "3 test files flagged as high-risk — 74% defect probability" | Based on historical change patterns for affected files; dismissable |
| Duration Labels | Per-stage elapsed time shown below nodes | Shows "—" for pending stages; "3m…" for running stages |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |

| Download / Verify / Provenance | Three inline actions per row | Download logs who downloaded and when; Provenance opens full chain-of-custody |
| Artefact Immutability | All uploaded artefacts are write-once; no overwrite or delete permitted | New version creates a new record; prior versions remain accessible and auditable |

| Profile Card | Avatar \+ editable profile fields: name, email, role, organisation | "Change Avatar" opens crop-and-upload modal; all changes require MFA confirmation |
| Persona & Vocabulary Card | Active persona chip \+ vocabulary impact list | "Change Persona" opens the same persona selector as SC-02 Onboarding |
| Notification Preferences | Per-category toggles: CCR approvals, security alerts, AI recommendations, builds, digest | Push, email, and in-app channels configurable per category |
| Security Card | Last login with location, MFA status, active session count | "Manage Sessions" lists all active sessions with revoke controls per device |
| MFA Status | "Enabled (TOTP)" shown in green | FIDO2 hardware key option available for compliance-tier tenants |
| API Keys | Not shown — accessible via sidebar; allows generating personal API tokens | Keys are scoped and expirable; activity log per key |

| SC-18 | Farm-to-Consumer Traceability UF-09 Traceability Query  →  Retailer provenance query in \< 10 seconds | *Agricultural* |
| :---: | :---- | ----: |

![][image18]

|  | Design Notes The provenance tree uses radial layout with nodes centred on their vertical positions. Node colours use the solution/domain accent colours to visually group by tier. The detail panel on the right is a 300px wide card that replaces generic drawer patterns for this screen. |
| :---- | :---- |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Query Result Header | Lot code, query completion time, export actions | Provenance query executes in \< 10 seconds across distribution \+ batch records |
| Provenance Tree | Interactive tree: Consumer Lot → Input Lots → Farms → Fields | Nodes are clickable to expand detail; zoom \+ pan on larger screens |
| Consumer Lot Node | Top-level node: consumer product lot code | Clicking shows distribution date, retailer, and cold chain events |
| Input Lot Nodes | Mid-tier nodes linking consumer product to raw material lots | Colour coded by origin farm certification status |
| Farm Nodes | Farm name \+ location; clicking opens farm detail panel on right | Shows IoT fleet size, certifications, and inspector details |
| Field Nodes | Lowest-level provenance: field section, harvest date, treatment history | Agronomic records accessible; IoT sensor history linked |
| Detail Panel | Selected Farm 2 — Valley Organics with 7 detail fields | All fields from the GS1 EPCIS event record; PDF export includes this panel |

| SC-19 | Security Incident — SDE Quarantine UF-05 Security Incident  →  Quarantine → Forensics → Recovery | *Software / Tech* |
| :---: | :---- | ----: |

![][image19]

|  | Design Notes The security incident screen uses RED throughout to communicate urgency: alert banner, state chip, threat score badge. The forensic log uses the same near-black terminal background as the pipeline log (SC-07). The recovery steps panel uses the same vertical timeline as the approval chain (SC-08). |
| :---- | :---- |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Alert Banner | Full-width red alert banner: "SECURITY ALERT — SDE api-gateway-sde QUARANTINED" | Appears across all screens simultaneously for the affected SDE owner \+ security team |
| Quarantined State Chip | "QUARANTINED" chip with red pulsing dot animation | Cannot be dismissed without completing the recovery workflow |
| Action Bar | Restore Clean SDE (primary), View Forensic Snapshot, Raise Emergency CCR | "Restore Clean SDE" triggers a 5-step recovery workflow with confirmation dialog |
| Threat Analysis Panel | Threat Score 94/100 CRITICAL \+ detection method \+ suspected vector \+ CVE reference | All values are from SEM event payload; CVE reference links to NVD database |
| Forensic Process Log | Chronological process tree: egress blocked, malicious process spawned, file access | Timestamps in milliseconds; process IDs \+ file paths recorded immutably |
| Recovery Steps Panel | Numbered steps with status: done (✓ green), running (⟳ blue), pending (⏸ grey) | Step 1 auto-completes on quarantine; steps 2-5 require human actions |
| Affected Solutions Panel | Solutions potentially affected by the compromised package — sorted by severity | HIGH \= immediate patch required; creates emergency CCR for each |

| SC-20 | State Transition Panel UF-02 Solution approval  ·  UF-04 QA batch release  ·  Any lifecycle transition | *All Domains* |
| :---: | :---- | ----: |

![][image20]

|  | Design Notes The state transition panel is a 480px right-side drawer. Each transition card uses a distinct colour (GREEN/AMBER/RED) for its border and accent. Blocked transitions use RED\_DIM fill to visually differentiate from interactive options. The entire panel pattern is reused unchanged across all solution types and domains. |
| :---- | :---- |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Current State Display | "In Review" shown prominently at top with amber chip | State chip is the same component as used inline in all solution headers |
| Available Transitions | Cards showing: Approve → Approved, Request Changes → Draft, Recall \[BLOCKED\] | Each transition shows all preconditions with ✓ (met) or ○ (unmet) indicators |
| Approve Transition | All 3 preconditions met (✓) — QA sign-off, CCRs resolved, spec artefact present | Confirm button activates only when a valid transition is selected |
| Request Changes | Requires a reason text field — Confirm button disabled until reason entered | Minimum 20 characters required; reason stored with audit event |
| Recall \[BLOCKED\] | Red-accented card showing "Only QA Director may initiate recall" | Blocked transitions are visible but cannot be selected; show why they are blocked |
| Precondition Checklist | Inline ✓/○/⛔ per precondition in each transition card | Unmet preconditions link to the blocker (e.g. "1 critical defect must be resolved") |
| Confirm Button | Full-width primary button at bottom of drawer | Disabled until valid transition selected; triggers transition \+ AUDIT\_EVENT publish |

| SC-21 | Notification Centre Entry from GlobalNav bell  ·  Supports all 12 user flows via action-required notifications | *All Domains* |
| :---: | :---- | ----: |

![][image21]

|  | Design Notes Notification cards use the left-border colour pattern consistently with all other status indicators across the platform. The unread dot sits outside the card at the left edge. Timestamps use relative format with absolute on hover. Error/security notifications are persistent until explicitly dismissed. |
| :---- | :---- |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Filter Tabs | All, Action Required, AI Insights, Security, System — with counts | Active tab has blue underline; counts update in real time |
| Mark All Read | Top-right action button — clears all unread indicators | Individual notifications can be dismissed with × on hover |
| Unread Indicator | Small dot on the left side of each unread notification card | Dot colour matches notification type (red \= security, amber \= action, purple \= AI) |
| ACTION REQUIRED Card | Amber left border \+ bold badge \+ title \+ detail \+ timestamp | Direct action link within card; "Review Now" routes to CCR list filtered to user |
| RELEASE BLOCKED Card | Red left border — release is gated until action is taken | Click routes directly to the Release Pipeline screen (SC-09) for the blocked release |
| AI INSIGHT Card | Purple border — recommendation ready for review | Click opens the AI Agent Panel (SC-13) scoped to the specific recommendation |
| SECURITY ALERT Card | Red border \+ bold badge — highest urgency level | Click routes to SC-19 Security Incident screen for the quarantined SDE |

| SC-22 | Factory Overview UF-10 New Organisation Onboarding  ·  Factory-level health monitoring | *All Domains (admin view)* |
| :---: | :---- | ----: |

![][image22]

|  | Design Notes The factory overview is the admin entry point for a Solution Factory. The 5-stat metric row uses large 28pt numbers in BLUE to give at-a-glance health status. Health bars show the overall operational posture. Policies are read-only indicators for non-admins; admins can click to toggle. |
| :---- | :---- |

**Element Annotations**

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Factory Summary Bar | Factory name, domain type, region, solution count, member count | Edit Factory Settings accessible to Factory Admin role only |
| Stats Row | 5 metric cards: Total Solutions, Active SDEs, Team Members, Open CCRs, Active Releases | All counts are live; click any card filters the factory view to that resource type |
| Factory Health Bar | Build Success Rate, CCR Compliance, Security Posture, AI Coverage with progress bars | All bars update in real time; below-threshold bars turn amber/red |
| Recent Solutions | Latest 5 solutions across all types with state, owner, timestamp | Click any row goes to that solution's detail (SC-05) |
| Team Panel | 4 members shown with role labels and avatar initials | "Invite Member" opens email invitation modal with role assignment |
| Active Policies Panel | Factory-level enforcement policies: SAST mandatory, attestation required, CCR for all changes, AI monitoring | Policy chips show "Enforced" (green) or "Off" (grey); policies set by Factory Admin |
| Factory Actions | "New Solution" (primary), "Invite Member", "Factory Settings" | New Solution opens the solution creation wizard scoped to this factory |

# **4\. Accessibility & Interaction Summary**

All 22 screens comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Key implementation requirements:

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Contrast | All text meets 4.5:1 minimum; primary text achieves 7:1 AAA | Never use colour as sole status indicator — always pair with icon \+ text label |
| Focus Rings | 3px blue (\#388BFD) outline, 2px offset on all interactive elements | Never suppress :focus-visible; custom ring replaces browser default universally |
| Keyboard Nav | All interactive elements reachable via Tab; arrow keys within groups | G+H \= Home, G+S \= Solutions, G+E \= Environments, Cmd+K \= Command Palette |
| Screen Readers | All status chips have aria-label; live regions on AI \+ pipeline updates | All icon-only buttons have aria-label; decorative icons are aria-hidden |
| Motion | prefers-reduced-motion respected; all animations replaced with instant/opacity | AI orb, pipeline stage ring, toast slide-in all affected by this setting |
| Touch Targets | 44×44px minimum for all interactive elements; 8px gap between targets | Bottom tab nav uses 44px height with 8px vertical padding |
| Mobile Zoom | All screens functional at 200% text zoom without horizontal scroll | Sidebar collapses to icon-only at md breakpoint; drawer at sm/xs |

# **5\. Component Inventory**

The following design components appear across the 22 screens. Each is implemented as a reusable React component in the @qala/design-system package.

| Element | Description | State / Behaviour |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| GlobalNav | Screens: all authenticated | Factory switcher \+ Command Palette trigger \+ notifications \+ AI orb \+ avatar |
| Sidebar Navigation | Screens: all except Login \+ Mobile | Domain-adaptive labels; 240px expanded / 64px icon-only collapsed |
| LifecycleStateChip | Screens: SC-03–SC-22 | Dot \+ label; 14 distinct states; WCAG AA on all background combinations |
| SolutionCard | Screens: SC-03, SC-04, SC-05 | Used in grid and list views; skeleton shimmer on load |
| QualityGateProgress | Screens: SC-07, SC-09 | Horizontal pipeline node pattern; ✓/⟳/⏸/✗ states |
| AIRecommendationCard | Screens: SC-03, SC-05, SC-13 | Purple accent; confidence bar; Accept/Dismiss/Defer actions |
| CommandPalette | Screen: SC-12 (accessible from all) | Cmd+K; 600px wide; grouped results; \< 100ms response |
| EventStreamFeed | Screens: SC-03, SC-10 | Real-time log with slide-in animation for new events |
| CCRForm | Screen: SC-08 (creation mode) | Multi-section adaptive form; live risk score; cascade preview |
| StateTransitionPanel | Screen: SC-20 (right drawer) | Precondition checklist; typed justification for high-risk transitions |
| ArtefactCard | Screen: SC-16 | SHA-256 digest; integrity verify; provenance chain link |
| ConfirmationDialog | Used by: state transitions, SDE decommission, recall initiation | Severity-coded; typed solution name required for critical actions |
